hero.title: Healthcare appointments, without the waiting.
hero.subtitle: Book appointments, track your queue, and connect with doctors efficiently.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Search and filter doctors by specialization, availability, and experience.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Select a convenient time slot and book your appointment online.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get real-time updates on your queue position and estimated wait time.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Visit the doctor at your turn. No more unnecessary waiting.

features.title: Features
features.smartSchedulingDesc: Intelligent appointment scheduling that prevents double-booking and optimizes doctor time.
features.realTimeQueueDesc: Live queue tracking with automatic position updates and wait time estimates.
features.secureRecordsDesc: Your medical records are stored securely and accessible only to authorized personnel.
features.multiLanguageDesc: Access the platform in English, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada.
